datePolicy: Retains original test/source access date 2026-11-06 Asia/Singapore; execution timestamps also occur on 2026-11-05 UTC. Every prose URL is in the original source register with the retained access date. Localization is not an external refresh, compatibility audit or new benchmark. No publication date is invented.
uncertainties: Assistant viewed a generated fixture contact sheet during preparation. The preview predates replacement of the initial cursive-font note with final pen-stroke paths. This is not a strict no-imagery-upload or air-gapped demonstration; scored OCR process trees alone were network-denied.

All documents are synthetic. Receipt is a generated phone-photo simulation; handwriting is generated pen strokes, not natural human writing. No private paperwork, real camera receipt or natural-handwriting corpus was tested.

One completed pass per configuration on one Apple M2 Mac; fixed engine/document order, no repeated-trial speed study or measured peak RAM. Shared-machine/cold-cache effects remain. Model file MB is not RAM.

CER preserves returned order; high scores can be layout-order failures. Whitespace-stripped primary CER can conceal merged words or extra Chinese spaces. Mean is unweighted across pages, not pooled and not a rating.

All 24 PDFs passed only the stated text-layer/at-least-one-query criterion. Call me exact phrase failed for Tesseract and EasyOCR stamped-page PDFs. Searchability does not establish every-word accuracy, complete indexing, all-viewer compatibility, exact highlights or editable tables.

Tesseract exports PDF natively; other workflows used the custom local ReportLab adapter. Vision GUI Live Text and OCRmyPDF were not tested. Vision wrapper and sandbox workflow are Mac-specific; internal Apple model size is unknown.

RapidOCR result is rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4 legacy baseline, not current rapidocr defaults or a recommendation to retain old production dependencies. EasyOCR used the bilingual configuration on all pages; English-only performance was not assessed.

EasyOCR project and upstream CRAFT code licences do not independently settle checkpoint-specific licensing or training-data rights. Adapter/evaluation dependency licences also matter for redistribution.

Original source folder contains replay assets, references and model hashes as local package evidence only; the page does not promise public downloads or tell website readers to open inaccessible local files. Original run model is unknown.
editingContract: Complete reader-first English and Simplified Chinese; all 24 tool/document results retain CER, whitespace-collapsed CER, OCR/PDF timing, limited searchability and meaningful errors; bilingual numeric/date/external URL multiplicities and corresponding table-cell parity. Local Markdown/data drafts only, no build/publication, no Review or stars.
